text.en:
The name of Culaman Elementary School in the Municipality of Jose Abad Santos, Province of
Davao del Sur, shall be changed to Harden Joyce Elementary School.

The record of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Sports bearing the name of the school
mentioned in Section 1 hereof shall be changed and be substituted by the name Harden Joyce Elementary

This Act shall take effect immediately upon its approval.
Approved: April 13, 1984
